facts.fact: Chad is implementing the Tchad Connexion 2030 strategy, whose period runs to 2030, with targets of at least 80 percent national internet coverage and about 80 percent mobile penetration and around US$1.5bn of ICT investment; the date is the document's published date, 2026-03-16.

slug: 2025-12-10 Chad Finalizes Digital Law to Align National Framework With Global Standards

facts.fact: The government has presented the national strategy Tchad Connexion 2030, with US$1.5bn of planned digital investment and a six-year horizon to 2031 at most, to extend digital coverage to most of the population; the document gives no presentation date, so its published date, 2025-12-10, is used.

TechAfrica News reports on 2025-07-18 that the government launched the US$1.5bn Chad Connection 2030 programme, running to 2030, to give most Chadians quality internet access, with fibre loops, a 509 km N'Djamena-Niger border fibre link and satellite coverage.
